content.title: Japan's Sojitz, JOGMEC team up with Alcoa for gallium study in Australia
content.summary: TOKYO (Reuters) -Japanese trading house Sojitz established a joint venture with Japan Organization for Metals and Energy Security (JOGMEC) to study gallium production in Australia, Sojitz said on Monday.  Gallium, a critical mineral, is used in semiconductors where demand continues to grow with the expansion of electric cars, mobile devices and other electronic items.
